note: Every ENFORCEMENT GAP id ever recorded. GROW-ONLY. This file exists OUTSIDE docs/enforcement-gaps.json on purpose: an independent reviewer demonstrated that deleting a gap record made the lint report clean with one fewer gap — the sweep obligation was escapable by removing the thing that creates it, the failure-shape stopped propagating to every future standard permanently, and the build called that clean. A floor kept inside the file it floors is not a floor. Retiring a shape is legitimate; doing it silently is not, so a retirement must be recorded here with a reason rather than by deletion. It also records everSweptGapIds: an independent reviewer showed that replacing a FINISHED sweep with an honest-looking absence plus a far-future countdown kept the build clean and reported the gap as dated-and-unswept — so work already done could be undone without a failure, and freshness ran in both directions. A gap that has ever been swept may not return to unswept.
